title: Space Trivia: Choose Your Difficulty
description: Get the first question right and the quiz gets harder. Miss it and you take the gentler route.

results.title: Cadet
results.text: Solid basics, so keep looking up.

results.title: Mission Commander
results.text: Outstanding; you know your way around the solar system.

intro.title: Mission briefing
intro.text: Answer correctly and the questions get tougher, but they are worth more points.

q1.text: Which planet is known as the Red Planet?
q1.explanation: Iron oxide (rust) on the surface gives Mars its red colour.

easy1.text: Which planet is the largest in our solar system?
easy1.explanation: Jupiter is more than twice as massive as all the other planets combined.

easy2.text: What do we call the star at the centre of our solar system?
easy2.explanation: The Sun holds 99.8% of the solar system's mass.

hard1.text: Which of these are gas giants? (Select all that apply.)
hard1.explanation: Jupiter and Saturn are gas giants; Neptune is usually called an ice giant but is grouped with them here.

hard2.text: What is the name of Saturn's largest moon?
hard2.explanation: Titan has a thick atmosphere and lakes of liquid methane.

end_commander.title: Mission Commander
end_commander.text: Top marks on the hard route. Take the captain's chair!

end_cadet.title: Cadet
end_cadet.text: A good flight. Try the other route for a different challenge.

end_rookie.title: Space Rookie
end_rookie.text: Plenty of room to grow. Have another go!
